subject: Preserve water dive across arrow trajectory recomputation
description: The old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_045/replay-003-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly diverged after frame 1191 on Projectile121's terminal lifecycle: Original had already retired the arrow at elevation `-0.0000019073486` with both movement flags false, while Rust left it active at elevation `0.001` with `movement_map.y=-0.0009765625` and both movement flags true. Original `RHElementProjectile::ComputeTrajectory` classifies a WATER endpoint by setting the persistent `mbDive` flag and returning, while HOLE instead appends a fall-into-hole trajectory (`original-code/RHelementprojectile.cpp:428-455,577-604`); it does not clear an earlier `mbDive` when a later `MakeFallingDown` recomputes a dry ricochet. At terminal flight, `RHElementProjectile::Hourglass` consumes retained `mbDive`, emits the plouf lifecycle, and returns false before `HitObstacle`, whereas an ordinary dry landing reaches `HitObstacle` and receives the bare-ground `0.001` elevation snap (`original-code/RHelementprojectile.cpp:1898-1928,2063-2092`). Commit `efe8f043c377eadb547abe6c34cb3c86feeef6ca` carries terminal WATER separately from HOLE through ballistic integration, initializes runtime projectile dive state, preserves that state with `|=` across falling-arrow recomputation, honors it before the terminal ground snap, retires the arrow while retaining its parity tombstone, and lets the retained flag own water impact presentation rather than reclassifying the later dry endpoint. `cargo test -p robin_engine water` passed 23/23 and `cargo test -p robin_engine falling_arrow` passed 4/4, including direct terminal-water classification, water-to-dive transfer with a later dry recomputation, and terminal retirement without a ground snap. A fresh optimized runner clears all five frame-1191 Projectile121 differences and advances the representative independently to frame 1291, where Soldier58 differs in animation (`173` versus `171`), command (`LookLeft` versus `Wait`), `ai.list_them` (`[]` versus `[Pc101]`), AI substate (`158` versus `183`), and detection view status (`1` versus `6`); it is not exact EOF. Same-save replay-002 remains unchanged at its independent frame-1394 Projectile118 layer/sector frontier (`0` versus `65535`), while `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_041/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` remains exact EOF across all 1,500 recorded frames.
